facts.fact: A WSIS Forum 2026 session record says the New Deal Technologique has 54 projects across 12 programmes and a ten-year budget of about USD 2 billion, of which over USD 700 million remains to be allocated.
The session record says a governance body chaired by the Prime Minister monitors the New Deal's alignment and impact; it names neither the body nor the act creating it.
